name: vue-dnd-kit
description: Drag and drop for Vue 3: the packages, the docs and the playground. Each folder installs on its own (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

scripts.test: npm run test --prefix packages/core && npm run test --prefix packages/actions && npm run test --prefix packages/devtools
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/core && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/actions && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/devtools && npm run typecheck --prefix playground
